subject: general
question:
The bar graph given below shows the earnings of three LIC agents (in rupees lakh) from LIC commission during the year 2018 to 2022. The total earnings of agent A is what per cent of the total earnings of agent C during the year 2020 to 2022? (Rounded off to 2 decimal places)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/38fc13dd52ff04eea293633f72d7dddec6d25752d5ac6ddd330487542176b555.png]
solution:
Formula used:

Required % = frac{{Total of A}}{{Total of C}} × 100

Calculation:

Total earnings of Agent A from 2018 to 2022 = 60 + 70 + 75 = 205 lakh

Total earnings of Agent C from 2020 to 2022 = 70 + 65 + 85 = 220 lakh

= (205)/(220) × 100

⇒ .9318 × 100

⇒ 93.18%

**∴ The required percentage is 93.18%**
